SYMPTOM: Search API hanging forever, curl requests never returning, browser stuck on 'Searching...'
CAUSE: Added console.log to a file via fs.writeFileSync in a Next.js App Router API route. Turbopack/edge runtime doesn't handle fs module properly — causes the route to hang silently.
FIX: Remove ALL fs imports and file writes from API routes. Use console.log (goes to terminal) or a dedicated logging service.
PREVENT: Never use fs in Next.js API routes — even a seemingly harmless writeFile causes indefinite hangs with Turbopack
